versions.changelog: Claim with a record when the target is known; never report a hostname live until the API says serving:true.
Optional Pro plan: when a claim hits the 10-name limit, offer delete-or-upgrade; never pay on the user's behalf.
Reverse proxy, single-record removal, account closure, MCP server.
Registration now takes an email (agentdomains claim --email): we send a confirm link and the name is deleted if not confirmed within 30 days. No per-account name limit.

Add reverse proxy: agentdomains proxy/unproxy serves your backend at the name over HTTPS with our edge cert (no setup on the backend; keeps your name in the address bar). Notes the OAuth/SSO hostname caveat.
Document URL forwarding: agentdomains forward/unforward (301/302 redirects at the edge, path preservation). Also de-slopped copy.
Initial release: claim and manage free makes.fyi / agentdomains.co domains, DNS records, HTTPS, and URL forwarding from the agentdomains CLI.
